categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily develops, manufactures, and sells semiconductor equipment including front-end semiconductor process equipment such as cleaning devices, electroplating equipment, vertical furnace tube series, coating and developing track equipment, PECVD equipment, stress-free polishing equipment, back-end advanced packaging equipment, and silicon material substrate manufacturing process equipment. It also provides customized, high-performance, and low-consumption process solutions to semiconductor manufacturers to improve production efficiency and yield while reducing costs.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include proprietary SAPS and TEBO megasonic cleaning technologies for uniform and damage-free wafer cleaning, multi-anode localized electroplating technology for copper interconnects, stress-free polishing technology combining electrochemical polishing and CMP, and advanced packaging electroplating techniques. The company also develops vertical furnace tube equipment, coating and developing track systems, and PECVD equipment with independent intellectual property rights. Manufacturing involves customized design and production based on customer orders, supported by intelligent logistics and supply chain management.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are leading semiconductor manufacturers primarily located in China mainland, Taiwan, and South Korea, including major players like SK Hynix, SMIC, Yangtze Memory Technologies, Huahong Group, and Hefei Changxin. The company serves the integrated circuit manufacturing industry, covering logic chips, DRAM, 3D NAND, advanced packaging, and compound semiconductors. The markets served include semiconductor wafer fabrication, advanced packaging, and silicon substrate manufacturing.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China mainland with significant sales and manufacturing presence in Shanghai and Wuxi. It also has subsidiaries and R&D centers in Hong Kong, South Korea, and the United States, serving global semiconductor markets. The majority of revenue is generated from China mainland, with expanding international market penetration in South Korea, Taiwan, and the US.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the semiconductor supply chain, focusing on the design, development, and manufacturing of semiconductor fabrication and packaging equipment. It also engages in procurement of key components and collaborates closely with upstream suppliers and downstream semiconductor manufacturers to provide integrated equipment solutions.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include continuous innovation in semiconductor cleaning, electroplating, and packaging equipment technologies with emphasis on high precision, high integration, and environmental sustainability. The company invests heavily in R&D, focusing on next-generation nodes (28nm and below), 3D NAND, DRAM, advanced packaging, and compound semiconductor processes. It pursues a differentiated international competition strategy, platform-based product development, and global customer expansion, supported by a strong patent portfolio and collaborative R&D teams in China and Korea.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through direct sales of semiconductor manufacturing equipment and related spare parts to semiconductor manufacturers. The company follows a direct sales model without distributors, securing orders via direct negotiation, agency promotion, and bidding processes. Revenue recognition occurs upon customer acceptance and product delivery, including installation and commissioning.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is among the top five semiconductor equipment suppliers in China, with a 23% market share in China's cleaning equipment segment and a 6.6% global market share. It competes with international giants such as DNS, TEL, LAM, and SEMES, which dominate the global market. The company differentiates itself through proprietary technologies like SAPS and TEBO and focuses on the Chinese mainland market while expanding internationally. It is recognized as a national-level specialized and innovative 'little giant' enterprise and a leading player in China's semiconductor equipment industry.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved revenue of approximately RMB 5.62 billion, a 44.48% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 1.15 billion, up 26.65%. Total assets reached RMB 12.13 billion, growing 24.35%, with net assets of RMB 7.67 billion, up 18.69%. The company maintains a strong cash flow position with operating cash inflows of RMB 1.22 billion. R&D investment accounted for 14.93% of revenue, reflecting a robust growth trajectory and commitment to innovation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes differentiated technology leadership with proprietary megasonic cleaning technologies (SAPS and TEBO) that ensure uniform energy distribution and damage-free cleaning for advanced semiconductor nodes. Its multi-anode localized electroplating and stress-free polishing technologies provide superior process control and cost efficiency. The integration of slot and single-wafer cleaning in Tahoe equipment reduces chemical consumption significantly, supporting green manufacturing. The company offers customized, high-performance, and low-consumption equipment solutions that improve production yield and efficiency, meeting diverse customer needs and environmental standards.
